scenarios.name: bitsadmin_download
scenarios.description: Real capture: bitsadmin.exe /transfer downloads a file from raw.githubusercontent.com into the user's Temp folder as a .ps1. The BITS service process does the transfer.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5: process bitsadmin.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: T1105 accepted: the BITS job brings a file onto the host.
